questions.q: Which of the following is a graphical representation of data?
questions.explain: Bar graphs are pictorial representations where bars of uniform width are drawn with equal spacing on one axis and heights proportional to values on the other.

questions.q: A bar graph is best used for
questions.explain: Bar graphs are most suitable for comparing individual data items visually. Each bar represents a distinct value or category.
questions.subject: Maths

questions.q: In a bar graph, equal spacing is maintained
questions.explain: In bar graphs, equal spacing is maintained between the bars on one axis to ensure visual clarity and uniformity.
questions.subject: Maths

questions.q: Which axis usually represents the variable in a bar graph?
questions.explain: In most bar graphs, the horizontal axis or x-axis represents the variable such as category names or time periods.
questions.subject: Maths

questions.q: The value of a variable is represented in a bar graph by
questions.explain: The height of each bar in a bar graph represents the value of the variable.
questions.subject: Maths

options: There are no gaps between bars
It is only for text data

questions.q: What type of data is best represented by a histogram?
questions.explain: Histograms are used to represent continuous class interval data such as age, weight or time.

questions.q: What is the class mark of 20 – 30?
questions.explain: The class mark of any class interval is the average of its upper and lower limits.

questions.q: Which graphical method requires class marks?
questions.explain: A frequency polygon uses class marks as x-values and corresponding frequencies as y-values to plot points. These points are then joined with line segments to form the polygon.
questions.subject: Maths

questions.q: To complete a frequency polygon, what should be added?
options: Extra class-marks at beginning and end
questions.explain: To complete a frequency polygon properly, two additional class marks are added—one before the first and one after the last class interval.
